name: MGS Seguros
verdict: Spanish mutual-origin insurer, unlisted, majority widely held; largest stake (19.01%) with the Fundación Mutua General de Seguros. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Transformed from mutual Mutua General de Seguros (founded 1907) into an S.A. in 2011 with mutualists as shareholders. No state, listed parent or controlling shareholder found in the company's own statutes and annual report.
